title: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
abstract: arXiv:2610.13334v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we explore in-context prediction of PDE solution fields using approximate pre-training data. In addition, inspired by the posterior predictive mean-based inference mechanism of the in-context learning in prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), we propose PDE-PFN, a prior-data fitted neural solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning. PDE-PFN builds on a PFN architecture with self- and cross-attention mechanisms of Transformer and is pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions generated by physics-informed neural networks, serving as diverse but not necessarily exact priors. translated_title: PDE-PFN：基于先验数据拟合的神经PDE求解器
translated_abstract: 受大语言模型（LLMs）具有广泛泛化能力以及对噪声或不可靠预训练数据的鲁棒性这一成功的启发，我们探索使用近似预训练数据对PDE解场进行上下文内预测。此外，受先验数据拟合网络中基于后验预测均值的上下文学习推理机制的启发，我们提出了PDE-PFN——一种通过上下文学习来近似PDE解的后验预测均值的先验数据拟合神经求解器。PDE-PFN构建于具有Transformer自注意力和交叉注意力机制的PFN架构之上，并在由物理信息神经网络生成的带噪声近似解上进行预训练，这些解作为多样但未必精确的先验。通过在一系列二维PDE上的实验，我们证明PDE-PFN在异构方程上实现了经验泛化，在噪声先验下表现出鲁棒性……
tldr: 提出了PDE-PFN，一种通过上下文学习近似PDE解的后验预测均值的先验数据拟合神经求解器，它利用物理信息神经网络生成的带噪声近似解进行预训练，实现了跨异构方程的泛化能力以及对噪声先验的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: PDE-PFN is a prior-data fitted neural PDE solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning, pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions from physics-informed neural networks, achieving generalization across heterogeneous equations and robustness to noisy priors.
